name: Jose Pierre Adams
notable_stories: Reported by family tradition to be the bastard son of John Quincy Adams, though records indicate Scotland or Virginia birth
He was reportedly accidentally poisoned while testing a variety of herb as a chemist
Immigrated in early manhood (probably the 1810s), settled in Jefferson County, VA
Served as executor of brother-in-law Thomas Hamilton's will in 1836
